WITH hand_tallies AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(p.throws, 'Missing') AS throwing_hand,
           COUNT(*) AS tally
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws, 'Missing')
),
hand_shares AS (
    SELECT throwing_hand,
           tally,
           1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_tallies
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM hand_shares
)
SELECT SUM(hs.tally) AS combined_tally,
       AVG(hs.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(hs.share - a.avg_share) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM hand_shares AS hs
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE hs.share > a.avg_share;
